independent_boundary.normalization: none; analytic bin masses span one full period

metric_definitions.gradient: maximum across lambda, V0, hnu, W, omega of intrinsic/count L-infinity vector-relative and integrated scalar-relative errors; gradients are analytic, not finite differences
metric_definitions.integrated_count: absolute relative error of the summed expected detector count
metric_definitions.pointwise: maximum elementwise abs(candidate-reference) / max(abs(reference), 1e-14), separately for the intrinsic observable and expected detector count

profile.description: fixed positive periodic spectral intensity followed by a fitted smooth transmission, detector-volume measure, and exposure; crossed cubic/oblique finite-energy cases

selection_rule: smallest candidate passing every threshold against both its doubled count and the 4096-node reference

wrapped_reference.tail_bound_method: first omitted coefficient divided by a geometric bound on all subsequent coefficient ratios, including both signs
